all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 890 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 61 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 31.4°S, 163.4°E, about 1,170 km from Sydney.
This far north, they're roughly level with Dallas, even though it's a world away.
